 versus
State Of Chhattisgarh Through The District Magistrate, Korba, District Korba, Chhattisga
 ... Resp
14.08.2024 Mr. Aditya Khare, Counsel for the Appellant.
Mr. Ajit Singh, Government Advocate for the State.

Heard on admission as well as on I.A. No.
01/2024, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail under Section 430 of BNSS.

By virtue of the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 29.07.2024 in Session Case No. 14/2015, passed by the Special Judge (Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe)
Prevention of Atrocities, Korba, Chhattisgarh , appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
Conviction Sentence Section 419 IPC Read R.I for 2 years and fine of with Section 34 of IPC Rs.
4,000/- in default of payment of fine further two months R.I. Section 420 IPC read with Five years with fine of Rs. section 34 of IPC 10,000/- failing with further rigorous imprisonment of five months.
Section 467 IPC read with Seven years, with fine of Rs. Section 34 of IPC 4,000/- failing with further imprisonment of five months.
Section 3(1)(iv) of SC and Three years along with fine ST Prevention of of Rs. 6,000/- failing which Atrocities Act, 1989 imprisonment of three month R.I.

sentences.text:

therefore, it is prayed that his application (I.A. No. 01/2024) may be allowed.
On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the State/Respondent has opposed the said application.

sentences.text: Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and also looking to the judgment passed by the Trial Court, the nature of offence, age of the appellant and specially looking to the detention period of the appellant, I am inclined to allow this application without commenting anything on merits of the case.

Accordingly, I.A. No. 01/2024 is allowed and the appellant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 20,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court and upon which the substantive jail sentence imposed upon the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal.

After being released on bail, he shall appear before the Registry of this Court on 27.09.2024 and thereafter he shall continue to appear before the Trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry on this behalf and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given by the said court till the disposal of this appeal.
In view of above, I.A. No. 01/2024 is allowed and stands disposed of.
List this case for final hearing in its due course.
